d: Days after three Christian families in West Bengal’s West Midnapore alleged that they were assaulted, threatened and forced to perform a ritual at a Durga Puja pandal, conflicting claims have emerged. The families maintain that they were attacked and taken to the pandal against their will. Local VHP leaders deny the allegations, saying no violence took place and that the families went to offer Pushpa Anjali voluntarily. Meanwhile, police personnel remain stationed outside the families’ homes as the investigation continues. In this ground report, we hear both sides of the story. Watch
